科研.title: Artificiality's First Exam: An LLM-Referenced C-test for Supraintelligence
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.14005v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Under the accelerated pace of AI development, any benchmark whose difficulty is calibrated with humans or current AI systems becomes circular, or saturates soon. How can we then evaluate machines that may become more capable than the current machines and the people who write the tests? One answer to the question hinges on inverse problems, inductive inference questions for which difficulty depends on the complexity of the underlying mechanism, given the observations and the previous knowledge. Levin's Kt, a computable variant of Kolmogorov complexity, puts a theoretical upper bound to that difficulty, balancing the simplest representation encoding for the mechanism and the logarithm of the time steps to run that mechanism. Previous tests derived from Levin's Kt, such as the original C-test, are based on minimalistic Universal Turing Machines (UTM), capable of very limited representations and no previous knowledge. Reasoning large language models (LLM) are UTMs that capture a compendium of human culture as knowledge, using prompts as natural language programs. This paper presents the first test based on Levin's Kt with LLMs as representational machines. Fresh test items can be produced at high difficulties, estimated in a ratio scale measured in bits, before any human or frontier model can solve them. We formalise the measure, devise a lightweight generation and certification pipeline, explore the effect of the power of the reference machine and the gap between examiner and examinee. We produce a first battery of certified items administered to twelve LLMs. The resulting agent characteristic curves decrease with difficulty, down to the uncharted high-difficulty region, the supra-intelligence window of items we can certify, yet beyond generations of frontier intelligence.

科研.title: The Silent Failures in Agentic Data Science
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.14115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models have significantly lowered the barrier to writing code. Naturally, this has also led to the development of data science agents that promise automating the design and execution of data science from task formulation to model development. Existing evaluations of agentic data science (agentic DS) assess downstream predictive performance and code correctness, providing preliminary insight in agentic DS capabilities. We argue that these evaluations overlook the fundamental principles of data science: methodological data science- and domain knowledge. As such, only assessing downstream performance masks methodological failures such as data leakage and inappropriate validation, limiting the development of robust agentic DS systems. In this paper, we evaluate agentic DS beyond accuracy from three different angles: 1) a large-scale analysis of failure modes in common agentic DS frameworks and models across 220 data science tasks, 2) a reusable and extensible test suite with curated data science tasks that test for six specific failures in a controlled manner, and 3) a qualitative assessment of agentic DS pipelines against expert solutions on Kaggle competitions. We find that the majority of agentic solutions contain at least one failure mode despite the complexity of agentic harness or model capacity. Moreover, we identify a positive correlation between the occurrence of data leakage failures and predictive performance, confirming the necessity to evaluate agents beyond accuracy. Our qualitative analysis shows that DS agents generally lack problem solving creativity and domain knowledge, compared to competition-winning data scientists. We believe that principled failure mode analysis, as presented here, should be integral part of agentic DS evaluations, and that the insights we surface will be key in developing trustworthy agentic DS pipelines.

科研.title: ClawLoop: Self-Improving Agents via Harness-Native Training Loop
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.14118v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven their deployment toward general-purpose harness environments, where LLM-based agents operate in sandbox workspaces and interact directly with file systems and shells. While numerous post-training pipelines exist for tool-use agents, their counterparts for harness-based agents remain scarce and are predominantly one-shot and teacher-dependent: a stronger external model synthesizes tasks and collects trajectories, the target agent is trained once, and evaluation results are consumed by human researchers rather than fed back into the loop. Such pipelines are inherently bounded by the capability of the external model and the scope of human prior, leaving no room for self-improvement. To address these limitations, we propose ClawLoop, a framework that enables self-improving without any external teacher model and with minimal prior dependencies. ClawLoop composes three phases into a self-sustaining cycle: Task Synthesis, which generates a diverse pool of training tasks via two complementary construction routines, applies diagnosis-conditioned difficulty growth followed by both agent-free and agent-based task validation; Training, which updates the agent via SFT and/or RL; and Diagnosis and Feedback, which analyzes the agent's rollout behaviors to produce a capability analysis report that will be used as feedback for task synthesis in the next iteration. Using Qwen3.6-27B as the loop model, ClawLoop yields consistent improvements on SkillsBench, Claw-Eval-Live, and ClawGym-Bench. The iteratively refined tasks are further transferred to smaller-scale Qwen3.5-4B and 9B models with gains across all benchmarks, validating data quality independently of the loop model.

科研.title: Correction Training for Diffusion Models
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.14136v2 Announce Type: new Abstract: Iterative sampling in diffusion models can lead to error accumulation due to exposure bias. The denoiser is trained on real images interpolated with noise, but at inference its inputs are constructed from its own imperfect predictions from the earlier steps, something it has never seen at training time. This might be one reason diffusion models often struggle without additional help, such as CFG. We introduce a correction step for diffusion models which attempts to reduce this training-inference gap. The corrector takes the base model's prediction as input and is trained against the same ground-truth target. This makes correction an explicit learning task, with training inputs provided by the base model. During sampling, at each denoising step, we iteratively refine the denoiser's clean-sample prediction. This allows us to correct predictions at intermediate denoising steps, preventing early artifacts from persisting into the final sample. Although the corrector is trained only on predictions from the base denoiser, it can be applied repeatedly to its own outputs at inference for better results. This simple framework leads to substantial improvement in sample quality while largely preserving diversity. We evaluate our method across DiT, SiT, and JiT. Our method substantially improves upon previously reported FID scores for unguided generation and, notably, unconditional generation, where producing high-quality samples without guidance has been particularly challenging. Our method achieves performance competitive with classifier-free guidance (CFG), and combining correction with CFG further improves diversity and reduces oversaturation typical of CFG. Finally, we show that the additional inference cost of correction can be amortized by distilling the refined predictions back into the base diffusion model, retaining the quality gains without additional inference-time overhead.

科研.title: Lotus: Learning to Understand Time-series by Learning to Forecast
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.18877v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-series language models typically align numerical signals with language using labels, captions, or question-answer pairs. Although such supervision encourages linguistic representations, it does not explicitly require them to preserve information about how the underlying time-series signal evolves. We introduce forecast grounding, a pretraining principle that requires language-aligned time-series representations to remain predictive of the future evolution before they are adapted to downstream tasks. We instantiate this principle in LOTUS, which divides each time-series channel into non-overlapping patches and maps them into the LLM embedding space. It then predicts the next patch from the LLM hidden states of the time-series tokens, encouraging the learned representation to retain temporal information. To capture both temporal changes and periodic patterns, we also propose a temporal-spectral patch representation that combines each raw time-series patch with its spectral representation before mapping it into the LLM embedding space. Across three language model backbones and six downstream evaluation datasets, LOTUS achieves the best average performance with minimal trainable parameters, reaching 59.91% accuracy and outperforming the strongest matched baseline by 3.36%. Our representation analyses further show that LOTUS uses the numerical input and preserves temporal structure in its learned patch representations. These results establish forecast grounding as a promising pretraining principle, enabling compact time-series language models to outperform models 25 to 50 times their size on TSRBench.

科研.title: Inverse Reasoning Models for Efficient Post-Training and Verification from Answer-Only Data
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.18878v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Post-training reasoning LLMs often requires making a tradeoff between costly supervision and compute inefficiency: supervised finetuning typically requires reasoning traces, which is data inefficient since in many applications one only has prompt-answer tuples and lacks the groundtruth chain-of-thought (CoT) sequence. On the other hand, reinforcement learning (with verifiable rewards, for example) can operate without CoT data but it is much more compute-inefficient since it requires multiple autoregressive completions per optimization step, none of which are guaranteed to give a non-zero policy gradient. In this work we explore a middleground, a self-distillation technique that uses answer-only data, treating CoT as latent variables. This relies on training a partner ``inverse reasoning LLM" that generates the original's reasoning traces conditioned on the answer. The inverse model is trained once and reused across incoming batches of answer-only data, with all generation happening offline and up front, making the approach particularly suited to continual post-training. Using Qwen3-0.6B on the Countdown and GSM8K tasks, we show that after GRPO training has saturated, a single offline distillation round from the inverse model roughly doubles pass@1 on hard prompts and, on Countdown, outperforms rejection-sampling self-distillation on every hard-tail metric at every mix ratio (with smaller gains on GSM8K); rejection sampling by construction has no signal on problems the model never solves on its own. Continued GRPO on the fresh data retains an edge at hard pass@1 but trails distillation at pass@8 and pass@32 while regenerating rollouts at every step. As an added bonus we see that the inverse model has a second application as an accurate verifier of correctness. When used for best-of-$n$ selection at test time, it raises selection accuracy on Countdown from 0.753 (majority voting) to 0.969.

科研.title: Do Vision CIL Methods Transfer to Protein? A Diagnostic Benchmark of Frozen Protein Encoders
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.18879v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Protein function annotation operates over an expanding label space, making class-incremental learning (CIL) a natural framework for incorporating newly discovered functions without full retraining. Yet existing CIL methods have been developed largely in vision and have not been systematically evaluated over frozen protein representations. We conduct a controlled benchmark of nine representative CIL methods across five sequence-, structure-, and sequence--structure-based protein encoders and two enzyme function datasets at different scales, while keeping the encoders frozen and evaluation settings consistent across representations. We find that no method transfers reliably across encoders, and that these failures persist across alternative phase constructions. Diagnostic analyses reveal that this instability arises from weak gradient-based stability signals, substantial heterogeneity in embedding geometry, and covariance assumptions whose appropriate capacity changes with both dataset scale and encoder. These findings suggest that the representation itself should be treated as a central component of continual-learning design rather than a passive feature extractor. More generally, reliable protein CIL will require encoder-aware methods that adapt their statistical assumptions and capacity to the geometry of the representation on which they operate. Code is available at https://github.com/zygao930/ProteinCIL.

科研.title: Do Perturbation Predictors Learn Gene Interactions? Diagnosing Extrapolation in Agentic Screening
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.18880v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-throughput perturbation screens increasingly use machine-learning models to predict the effects of gene combinations that were never measured. A difficult case arises when both genes in a test pair were seen individually during training, but their combination was not. In this setting, standard OOD methods often fail because neither gene appears unfamiliar on its own. We therefore compare each model prediction with a simple additive prediction obtained by summing the two observed single-gene effects. The difference between them, which we call additive disagreement (AD), measures how much extra interaction effect the model introduces for an unseen combination. Across eight prediction methods and three Perturb-seq datasets, specialised neural predictors do not consistently outperform this simple additive baseline. More importantly, predictions with larger deviations from the additive baseline tend to have larger errors. Conventional output-based and embedding-based confidence signals are inconsistent across datasets and models, whereas AD remains informative across all evaluated compositional settings. We further study how this signal can guide decisions in an agentic perturbation-screening workflow. The code is available at https://github.com/zygao930/OOD.

科研.title: Electron-Mediated Phonon Polaritons in Quantum Cavities
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.18999v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phonon-photon coupling in quantum materials is commonly treated as an effective direct interaction, neglecting the crucial role played by electrons. Here we develop a gauge-invariant theory of cavity phonon polaritons that captures electronic screening, dissipation, and hybridization. We show that screening can suppress polariton formation in metals, severely constraining cavity control of phonon-mediated superconductivity. By contrast, interband electronic resonances in time-reversal-symmetric gapped systems can strongly enhance phonon-photon coupling, enabling robust polariton formation down to the monolayer limit despite electronic absorption. We illustrate these effects in NbSe2, hBN, and gapped graphene. Finally, we show that gauge invariance enforces photon decoupling from a critical soft phonon, establishing a general no-go mechanism for photon condensation.

科研.title: Engineering Correlated Transparent Conductors via Metal-Insulator Transition Proximity
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.19112v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transparent conductors are key functional materials in modern optoelectronic devices. Their performance is governed by an inherent trade-off between optical transparency and electrical conductivity. Correlated metallic oxides offer an attractive workaround to this compromise, where narrow partially-filled bands provide high conductivity, while the absence of visible-range transitions enables optical transparency. Despite this promise, transparency and conductivity remain coupled through carrier density and electronic coherence. Here, we use proximity to a metal-insulator transition (MIT) as a design principle for engineering this balance in correlated-oxide transparent conductors. Epitaxial Ti-substituted $SrVO_3$ films serve as a model platform where the optical window and metallicity are tuned simultaneously. We demonstrate and explain a systematic broadening of the optical window to regimes relevant for silicon photovoltaics. This gain is counterbalanced by carrier depletion and disorder, which drive the loss of coherent transport near the composition-driven MIT. A Haacke figure-of-merit analysis identifies the optimal composition range near the MIT, where the loss of metallic transport is accompanied by persistent near-Fermi-level spectral weight, indicating disorder-assisted localization together with correlation-driven spectral-weight redistribution. These findings establish proximity to an MIT as a general materials-design strategy, using electronic filling as a tuning knob for the transparency-conductivity balance in correlated-oxide transparent conductors.

科研.title: Symmetry-selected extreme shear compliance in a stable carbon monolayer
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.19168v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solids that are stiff to most loads and extremely compliant to one are normally built, not found. That internal atomic relaxation lowers elastic constants is textbook; what has remained untested is whether it can be driven far enough to separate the elastic scales of a crystal by an order of magnitude while leaving it mechanically stable. Density functional theory calculations of the complete in-plane elastic tensor of four non-hexagonal carbon monolayers sharing a square lattice metric show that it can: their longitudinal stiffnesses agree to within a factor of two while their shear constants span more than a factor of fifty. Twin T-graphene, previously reported as elastically isotropic from normal strains alone, is the extreme case, with $C_{66}=3.03$~N\,m$^{-1}$, nearly fifty times below graphene, at an axial stiffness typical of semiconducting monolayers, and a soft Kelvin eigenvalue a factor of $29$ below the others while the Born criteria hold. Symmetry confines the strain-induced relaxation to the $B_{2g}$ sector, a counter-torsion of the carbon sublayers about the short mid-plane bonds that removes $96\%$ of the clamped-ion shear stiffness with almost no bond stretching and leaves the semiconducting gap intact. Transverse acoustic phonons, finite-temperature dynamics, and large-deformation simulations show that the channel survives beyond the harmonic, zero-temperature limit. Because the selection rule is a point-group statement rather than a chemical one, it yields a screening criterion for other crystals and other strain components.

科研.title: Atomic ironing for conformal interfaces in freestanding oxide nanomembranes
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.19275v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomically well-defined interfaces are essential for realizing functional interlayer coupling in stacked and twisted oxide heterostructures, yet transferred freestanding oxides can develop structural inhomogeneities, including local curvatures, interfacial voids, and incomplete contacts with substrates. Here, we demonstrate that these transfer-induced structural disorders and imperfections evolve substantially and can be suppressed by post-transfer thermal treatments, yielding bulk-like crystalline freestanding oxide nanomembranes. Using freestanding SrTiO3 membranes as a model system, we report a systematic understanding of the role of "atomic ironing" and the associated evolution of lattice mosaicity, interfacial roughness, and optical bandgap. We further demonstrate atomically bonded conformal interfaces in twisted SrTiO3 heterostructures, highlighting the importance of post-transfer thermal processes. These results establish a synthetic strategy to restore the structural integrity and intrinsic bulk-like functionality of freestanding oxide nanomembranes, enabling stacked, twisted, and heterogeneously integrated oxide architectures with atomically well-defined interfaces for emerging quantum functionalities.

科研.title: Topologically Protected Surface Acoustic Wave Edge States in Phononic Integrated Circuits
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.19259v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phononic integrated circuits enable the development of compact systems to manipulate radio frequency signals through interconnected networks of acoustic waveguides. Introducing topologically protected robustness in these circuits to counter fabrication imperfections and local perturbations, remains a challenge. This work presents a validated modeling framework for topologically protected edge states using surface acoustic waves in etch-defined waveguides consisting of scandium aluminum nitride on silicon carbide, directly comparing analytical, full-wave numerical simulation, and laser Doppler vibrometer measured experimental approaches and their agreement. This work represents the first experimental demonstration of topological edge states on a ScAlN on SiC platform, validated through direct quantitative comparison with analytical and numerical analyses, with future implications for topological protection in phononic and optomechanical integrated circuit platforms.

科研.title: Effect of deep-trap density of states for a-Si:H layers on HIT cell performances: Modeling Framework
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.20517v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, an aSi and cSi heterojunction solar cell with an intrinsic layer is simulated using AFORS-HET software. The study focuses on the role of the electronic density of states DOS of the amorphous emitter, p type aSiH, in governing the performance of the HIT cell and the electronic transfer across the heterointerface. It is found that the DOS of the p type aSiH emitter can cause an unfavorable recombination and trapping effect, which becomes more severe and difficult to avoid when the bulk dangling-bond density in the a-Si emitter approaches or exceeds the doping concentration. An increase in deep trap density beyond a critical value causes a drop in the built in voltage and shifts the depletion layer into p type aSi. This situation leads to a sharp decline in HIT cell performance, namely the open circuit voltage and the fill factor, and to the appearance of an S shaped IV characteristic. The simulation results suggest that the emitter activation energy needs to be optimized to achieve high efficiency. Under optimal conditions, holes accumulate near the heterojunction interface, leading to the formation of an inversion layer. This paper presents a physical mechanism for recombination processes within the emitter and concludes with the optimized parameters required to achieve a HIT cell efficiency comparable to Sanyo record of 23 percent on a thin silicon wafer.

科研.title: High-resolution retinal matrix imaging via computational motion and aberration correction
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.19245v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: High-resolution optical imaging of the human retina is essential for diagnosing ophthalmic and neurodegenerative diseases. While adaptive optics combined with coherence gating can resolve retinal structures at the cellular scale, it requires complex, costly, and cumbersome hardware to physically correct for ocular aberrations and motion. Matrix imaging offers a powerful digital alternative by leveraging wave linearity to undo aberrations and multiple scattering; however, its in vivo deployment has been hindered by continuous, involuntary eye movements that destroy phase coherence during acquisition. Here, we overcome this fundamental barrier and demonstrate the first in vivo reflection matrix imaging of the human retina using an ultra-simplified optical setup without physical correctors. We introduce a fully computational framework that tracks and compensates for multi-axial ocular motion directly from raw interferometric data, thereby restoring the phase coherence of a multi-spectral distortion matrix. This enables local, high-order aberration correction to achieve diffraction-limited, volumetric imaging of retinal tissues. By shifting the hardware burden to physics-guided numerical computation, this paradigm opens the way for accessible, non-invasive, and high-resolution digital ophthalmology.

科研.title: Strong field confinement in air and enhanced optical Kerr nonlinearity of high-index star-shaped pore membrane metasurfaces
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.19412v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The optical Kerr effect in high-refractive-index membrane metasurfaces patterned with a square lattice of five-pointed star-shaped pores is investigated numerically using gallium phosphide as a model material. The star geometry supports resonances with pronounced electromagnetic energy confinement, including an anapole state. The sharp tips of the star-shaped pores concentrate the electric energy density in air, exceeding that of Mie voids by a factor of seven. The effective second-order refractive index is enhanced by up to three orders of magnitude relative to bulk GaP, with the largest values obtained near the anapole resonances. The nonlinear response remains stable under polarization rotation and random misalignment of the nanoholes, indicating tolerance to fabrication imperfections. These results establish star-shaped pore lattices in freestanding membranes as a promising platform for nonlinear optics exploiting strong field confinement.

科技.title: 卖出去≠全球化成功，中国企业出海究竟还差什么？
科技.summary: 中国的汽车产业，正陷入前所未有的冰火两重天夹击。 2025 年，中国企业的全球销量 2700 万辆，首次超越日本；其中出口 832 万辆，相较十年前的 72.82 万辆增长超 10 倍。 但销量曲线向上的同时，利润曲线却在一路向下。2026 年上半年，国内汽车销售的利润率已经跌到了 1.52%，创下 10 年最低纪录。 出海也由此从选择题变成必答题。但出海并不只是把货卖出去这么简单，本地团队、合规体系、运营能力，需要环环相扣。有时候，一辆汽车交付到海外用户手中之后，真正的考验才刚刚开始。 小鹏集团对此体会深刻。作为国内头部物理 AI 科技公司，小鹏自 2020 年就开始加速布局欧洲，但考虑到欧洲各个国家对数据隐私的特殊要求，想要在当地快速推广智驾与智能网联服务并不是一件容易的事情。 而针对这些问题，服务了全球 超过 80% 的世界 500 强选的亚马逊云科技早已驾轻就熟。 为此，小鹏选择借助亚马逊云科技在海外构建数据湖，直接继承亚马逊云科技的安全合规认证，构筑起安全合规、网络安全、用户隐私保护等完善的解决方案，提升驾驶和出行体验，加速全球的业务扩张。 此后，小鹏又 以 Amazon Bedrock 作为基础模型底座，引入 Kiro 作为编程内核 ，并深度集成了 Strands Agents SDK、Model Context Protocol（MCP）及长年累积的汽车行业能力，构建了具备行业核心开发知识的 AI 编程与 Agentic AI 工作平台「灵犀」。可以让 AI 深度参与需求、设计、任务、开发、测试、审查到发布的研发全生命周期，帮助研发与业务部门快速将想法转化为可验证、可交付的实际成果。 类似的变化，也在越来越多中国企业身上发生。 对汽车、零售、软件、游戏在内一众行业来说，关于出海，企业的关注重点已经从过去的渠道扩张、销售增长，变化为如何在海外经营品牌、服务用户，甚至建立研发、生产与管理体系。 但市场越大，经营越复杂。 一家企业进入十几个国家，意味着它可能需要同时面对十几套不同的法律法规、语言环境、采购方式和服务体系。业务规模可以快速扩大，企业却无法永远依靠增加人员、重复建设系统来应对增长。 AI 恰好为破解这一难题带来了新的可能。 过去，翻译大量商品资料、处理多语言客服请求、编写程序和制作营销内容，都需要投入相应的人力。生成式 AI 已经开始承担其中不少重复性工作。随着 Agent 的发展，AI 还能进一步读取企业数据、调用软件工具，参与库存管理、客户服务、软件研发等更复杂的业务流程。 全球化企业自此不必让运营成本与业绩以相同速度增长。 但新的问题也随之而来：一个在中国市场验证成功的 Agent，能否安全、稳定地部署到十几个不同的国家？不同行业之间的经验与教训又有哪些共性与不同？ 亚马逊云科技在 10 月 13 日至 14 日，深圳举行的 2026 亚马逊云科技软件企业峰会暨 Marketplace 用户大会或许可以给我们一些启发。 大会现场，会从这些问题出发，以「软件企业峰会+Marketplace 买家大会+卖家大会」的形式，探讨 Agentic AI 如何走向实际业务、企业如何在全球采购技术能力，以及中国软件如何进入海外市场。 01 好产品，为什么不一定卖得出去？ 对于一家中国公司来说，技术领先、好产品并不等于能够顺利拿下海外客户。 尤其是金融、汽车等行业的大型企业， 即使技术团队已经认可产品，采购仍可能需要经历供应商准入、安全审查、合同谈判、财务审批等一系列流程 。 更现实的是，全球市场足够大，软件的复制成本几乎为零，但销售网络不可能一夜建成——进入不同国家，往往需要当地合作伙伴、商业渠道和客户关系。 OceanBase 曾经面对的，就是这样的难题。作为知名的原生分布式数据库厂商，OceanBase 早在 2022 年下半年就已经启动海外业务，但那时，团队还尚未组建海外本地化团队，而数据库又偏偏是一个对信任、可靠性、稳定性要求极高的领域。 为了解决这一问题，OceanBase 选择上架亚马逊云科技 Marketplace，并基于 Amazon EC2 等基础设施完成部署。借助平台生态，它无需在各国铺网点，就能触达印尼、马来西亚、日本的企业客户；客户在熟悉的云环境里采购，支出纳入现有云账单。 最终，靠着这套能力，OceanBase 拿下了一家东南亚千万用户级的电子钱包企业，支撑起持续增长的交易量、短时间涌入的大量并发请求，以及大型活动带来的瞬时流量洪峰。 此后，凭借 TP、AP、向量检索的一体化架构设计，以及 Amazon Bedrock（仅海外区使用）的 AI 服务对接，OceanBase 在一个零售行业实践案例中，帮助用户实现了实时推荐功能的开发周期缩短 30%。 时至今日，OceanBase 已经在港澳、东南亚、日韩、中东、印度等多地搭建本地团队，OB Cloud 云服务覆盖全球 60 多个区域、240 多个可用区，服务金融、零售、制造、互联网等多行业客户。 销售端在加速，采购端也在变得更高效。 用亚马逊云科技 Marketplace 全球买家大会上，亚马逊云科技中国区行业集群总经理沈涛的分享来说，就是「 出海每深入一步，采购需求就升一级」。 而关于如何解决这些财税、合规、简化采购流程等等一系列问题，同一场大会上，国泰数码及信息科技董事方逸翔表示，他们借助亚马逊云科技 Marketplace 实现了：简化采购流程、加快业务交付；统一管理第三方软件账单与授权许可；以及供应商尽职审核与定制产品目录，落地标准化风险治理。 同样受益的，还有全球实时音视频与对话式 AI 平台声网（AGORA）。他们每月处理超过 800 亿分钟通信量，服务着全球数十万开发者和数千家企业客户。为支撑这些业务，AGORA 需要持续采购数据库、安全防护、运维监控等第三方软件。过去，每新增一家供应商，就意味着新一轮商务谈判、合同签署、财务审批和后续管理。随着海外业务扩大，不同软件的采购和续约时间、账单以及管理规则越来越分散…… 要如何解决这些问题？ 10 月 13 日 Marketplace 买家大会主论坛「全球视野下的企业采购与软件采用」中，将这个问题拆解成了：全球财税差异与合规处理、跨账户账单统一、云投资价值管理，以及如何利用 Agentic AI 提高采购效率几个核心话题，并给出了解法： 借助亚马逊云科技 Marketplace 已经覆盖的 190 多个国家和地区，和约 33 万活跃企业买家与 300 万款软件产品，企业可以通过平台发现、购买和部署第三方软件、数据及服务，并利用私有报价、统一账单、采购目录等机制改善采购管理，对于出海企业，也可以将不同区域的软件需求纳入相对统一的采购与治理流程。 AGORA 也借助亚马逊云科技 Marketplace 集中管理了第三方软件采购，并在引入 Couchbase 数据库时，与本地合作伙伴锦木合作完成产品选型、性能测试及部署。这使得原本需要跨时区反复沟通的技术和商务问题，能够获得更及时的本地支持。截至目前，AGORA 使用 Marketplace 约三年，累计采购金额超过 100 万美元，涉及 5 家独立软件供应商。 当然，交易撮合只解决了企业的销售端问题；在 AI 时代，全球化真正落地具体业务之后，问题往往还要更复杂。 02 生意做到了海外，考验才刚刚开始 AI 时代的出海，是一项需要长期投入、且随时变化丛生的工程。 总结来说，企业面临的变化有三大共性。其一，AI 已经从辅助工具升级为可以自主感知、决策、行动的生产级智能体，并嵌入企业的规模化经营。其二，AI 已经从传统的数字任务落地到真实的产线、仓库与车间之中。其三，一朵能支撑全球合规、全球部署、全球运营的云底座，是让 AI 能力从中国市场无缝扩展到全球市场的基础。 具体实践中，除了汽车行业的小鹏，即使是已经有着丰富全球化运营经验的传统制造业，在出海时也同样面临不小的挑战。 比如来自智能硬件行业的安克创新，目前已经在全球 140 多个国家和地区开展业务，服务超过 2 亿用户。在这背后，早在 2017 年，安克就开始将核心业务系统部署到亚马逊云科技。到了 2023 年，安克进一步推动企业内部的 AI 普及战略。 不过，与简单地给员工配备 AI 助手不同，安克还试图把 AI 带入研发、营销、客户服务和财务等日常业务，建设了企业级 AI 平台 AIME，支持不同业务团队根据实际需求开发智能体，并将 AI 能力与已有的业务系统、数据和工作流程连接起来。 目前，安克已经部署超过 300 个活跃 AI 智能体，超过 50% 的代码由 AI 生成，约 70% 的客户支持工单通过 AI 解决。AI 正在从个人效率工具，逐渐进入全球化企业的组织和业务流程。 如果说安克代表了智能硬件企业把 AI 内化到组织流程的路径，紫讯则展示了一家软件公司如何把 AI Agent 做成产品本身。 作为一家专注于跨境电商服务的科技公司，紫讯推出的浏览器自动化智能体 BrowserAct，让用户用自然语言描述需求即可构建端到端「 数据 Agent 」，自动完成跨渠道表单填写、竞品数据抓取、舆情监控等复杂任务。凭借无代码、高精度的体验，BrowserAct 用户规模半年内增长超 300%，工作流处理量达百万级。 但流量爆发带来了新的工程挑战：突发流量与启动延迟。此后，紫讯通过 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 重构了运行时架构，任务调度从分钟级缩短到 1-2 秒，实现「 0 等待 」；按 CPU 实际用量计费，也使得大规模运行下成本效率显著提升。借助 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore，BrowserAct 还实现了面对数百万级工作流仍保持全球低延迟与 99% 的高可用性。 同样做软件开发，相比紫讯，游戏企业还需要回答另一个问题：当内容生产变得越来越容易，如何让产品继续保持吸引力？ 国产多人派对游戏《猛兽派对》的诞生，最初与复杂的技术架构并没有太大关系。 所思科技创始人罗子雄喜欢动物，自己养了一只柯基犬，也收养过流浪猫。后来，那只柯基成了《猛兽派对》的默认角色和吉祥物 Nemo。 团队想做的是一款由动物担任主角、可以让玩家轻松互动的多人游戏。 但让一群可爱的动物在屏幕里打闹，与让世界各地的玩家同时进入游戏，完全是两回事。 多人在线游戏对网络延迟和服务器稳定性有很高要求。玩家数量也可能随着活动、假期和市场热度快速波动，高峰期与低谷期的同时在线人数甚至相差数十倍。这意味着，游戏公司不能只把服务器部署到海外，还要考虑全球不同地区的实时匹配、弹性扩容和持续运维。 所思科技技术负责人李永一曾解释，团队之所以选择 Amazon GameLift 等服务，主要考虑的就是全球部署和低延迟体验，希望在提升研发、运维效率的同时，保证各地玩家都能获得稳定、流畅的游戏体验。最终，借助 Amazon GameLift，《猛兽派对》测试版在 2020 年于 Steam 获得最高 13 万玩家同时在线的成绩；2023 年 9 月正式版发行后，进一步服务来自欧洲、美洲、亚洲等多个市场的玩家。 03 用好亚马逊云科技， 正成为企业全球化经营的关键能力 回看这些企业的经历，可以发现中国企业出海最复杂的问题，往往并不发生在某一项技术内部，而是产品之外的合规、稳定性、需求对接、服务一致性 。 小鹏需要将车辆数据系统部署到海外，既保证智能化服务，又要管理数据安全和隐私；美的需要让不同国家的客服中心共同运行；AGORA 希望海外团队可以灵活采购软件，同时让总部保持统一管理；安克则希望把 AI 从单个员工的工具，变成可以在整个组织中使用的能力。 这些问题无法靠单独采购一个模型或者部署几台服务器解决 。 也是在这一背景下，今年亚马逊云科技提出了「三横一纵」能力体系： 「三横」包括全球基础设施及云与 AI 服务、安全合规，以及全球资源与合作伙伴网络；「一纵」则指向行业，以 AI 加速具体业务场景的创新和运营。 为此，亚马逊云科技带来了 Amazon Bedrock、Bedrock AgentCore 等服务，为企业提供了模型应用、智能体运行、身份管理、工具连接和可观测性等方面的技术能力。 以安全合规为例，过去，企业主要需要防范数据泄露、系统漏洞和恶意访问。现在，当智能体能够访问企业知识库、调用外部工具甚至执行业务操作时，还要考虑它会不会被恶意指令误导、越权访问敏感数据，或者作出超出授权范围的决定。亚马逊云科技围绕这一变化，形成了两个相互关联的方向：一方面保护 AI 工作负载本身，通过身份管理、内容防护、权限控制和审计追踪，让智能体的行为处于可控范围；另一方面利用 AI 辅助威胁检测、安全分析和风险响应，提高企业的安全运营效率。 当然，通用技术和全球资源并不意味着所有行业可以使用同一种方案。 汽车制造需要车联网、工业数据和全球售后系统，零售电商关注商品、供应链和交易安全，游戏泛娱乐则需要低延迟的全球服务、内容生产和实时运营能力。 这也是三横一纵存在的最终价值：将通用的云与 AI 服务，与不同产业已经验证过的技术架构和业务经验结合，使企业不必每进入一个新市场、推出一个新业务，就从零开始解决所有问题，最终帮助企业完成从单次产品交付走向长期全球经营的转变。 *头图来源：AI 生成 本文为极客公园原创文章，转载请联系极客君微信 geekparkGO

科技.summary: 155 款应用拒绝豆包助手 AI 自动化操作 10 月 14 日，豆包手机助手《屏幕自动化操作声明协议》（SAEP）30 天公示期结束，官方公布名单显示，已有 155 款第三方应用拒绝 AI 自动化操作，腾讯、阿里、美团、快手旗下多款产品，连同 Kimi、DeepSeek 等 AI 产品均在名单内，堪称互联网头部厂商的集体表态。 SAEP 协议核心是将 AI 屏幕自动操作的选择权交还应用开发者，开发者可自主决定是否允许豆包助手执行屏幕识别、模拟点击等操作。公示期内应用默认不开放权限；公示结束后，未明确拒绝的应用将按风险分级逐步开放，拒绝方后续也可随时调整声明。该自动化权限仅影响 AI 代操作，不影响用户手动使用 App。 此前，努比亚 NaviX Ultra 搭载豆包手机助手发售，就出现过设备触发游戏风控等冲突，这类矛盾过去长期处于隐性博弈状态。本次拒绝名单基本集中在拥有独立流量闭环的平台，安全风险、流量主权是核心考量。SAEP 把隐性冲突转为公开规则协商，标志移动端 AI 入口权博弈正式开启。行业认为，这只是智能体时代生态确权的起点，后续权限细化、责任划分、利益分配仍需多方持续磨合。（来源：极客公园） 相关报道： 第一款 AI 手机，被半个互联网「拒」了 腾讯上线绿泡泡短剧 近日，腾讯低调上线绿泡泡短剧，主打「免费好剧，一点就看」。 绿泡泡的界面分为「免费剧场」「刷一刷」和「我的」三部分。「免费剧场」下设「AI 剧」「真人剧」「每日上新」「动漫剧」「本周必看」「百万播放」等栏目。点开中间入口「刷一刷」，上下滑动即进入沉浸式推荐流。剧集全部免费，但会在剧集之间插入广告。 《短剧小程序用户协议》显示，服务签订主体为深圳市腾讯计算机系统有限公司。协议同时写明，短剧均来自第三方提供方，包括第三方小程序、短剧制作方、授权发行方等，由其授权本服务展示、播放。 和红果短剧相比，绿泡泡的社交印记更重。除了常规排行榜，首页还有「朋友在看」的短剧推荐，以及标注「北京的朋友都在看」的地区热门榜。腾讯方面表示，为提供个性化内容，会收集用户的浏览、观看、分享、点赞、评论、收藏等记录，以及朋友看过的剧目。经过程序分析后，平台会预测用户的偏好，朋友在看什么，直接影响给相关用户推什么。 这并非腾讯首次下场做短剧。2021 年 12 月，腾讯视频发布业内首个微短剧品牌「十分剧场」，当时它只是长视频 App 里的一个频道页。2025 年 1 月，「火星短剧社」在微信上线，后改名「火星观剧」，是腾讯首款独立短剧产品。2025 年 6 月，微信上线名为「短剧」的官方小程序。到 2026 年 10 月，这个小程序已找不到入口，位置让给了绿泡泡。（来源：北京日报） 小鹏发布智能汽车解决方案业务 2026 移动睡眠呼吸暂停迹象提示软件可以在你睡眠期间监测呼吸紊乱，并会在监测到持续性中度到重度睡眠呼吸暂停迹象时通知你。 据悉，该功能早在 2024 年便已登陆部分市场的 Apple Watch，可帮助用户识别中度至重度睡眠呼吸暂停迹象。 具体是如何识别的？苹果官方回应：基于深度学习算法及临床测试数据集构建，利用手表内置的加速感应器监测手腕细微动作以评估正常呼吸节律中断情况。
